description: Use when the user asks who a Steam player is or wants everything known about one account in a single call: Steam summary, Steam ban status (VAC/game/community), SteamID conversions, FACEIT stats and the first 100 friends. include LIMITS the response to the blocks you list: omit it for everything, ["steam"] for the Steam block only (cheapest), ["bans"] for a ban check only, ["faceit","bans"] to drop the friend list; friends_limit caps the friend list (default 100). Responses carry provenance.fresh and sources/partial - branch on them, not on nulls. Do not use for several players (steam_batch) or for a single fact (steam_bans, steam_faceit, steam_convert are cheaper).

friends_detail.description: friend entry shape, default full; short/medium are much smaller

friends_limit.description: max friends in the response, default 100

id.description: any SteamID format: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a steamcommunity.com link or a vanity name

include.description: restricts the response to the listed blocks; omit for bans+faceit+friends. Example: ["bans"] returns the Steam summary plus ban status only

name: steam_summary

canonical.description: steamid64 and canonical URL of this player

friends.description: friend entries, shape set by friends_detail

ids.description: the same account in every SteamID format

partial.description: true when at least one source was unavailable

provenance.description: per source: retrieved_at, age_seconds, fresh, cache_ttl

sources.description: per block: ok | empty | unavailable | excluded

steam.description: raw Steam GetPlayerSummaries object, null when the Steam block is unavailable

steam_bans.description: Steam ban fields exactly as Steam reports them

title: Steam profile summary
